items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I remember one of the associates in our dance orchestra very well. His name was -- his name was Phil Lambert

ctx.x: Did you think that was what you wanted to play?

Well, I wanted to play all of them. Our family had a feeling, it seemed, for music, and we could acquire a capability of playing any type of music. I tried everything from symphony to concert to jazz, all those music. It seemed very easy for me to acquire the feeling, and so by the time I was into high school, I was playing all of these different types of music fairly well. Of course, I was continually in the school bands, the school orchestras, and I had even gotten so I could play in the school dance band,…
